title: M9-C42.26 — Mutation Score Trajectory Interpretation
principle: Do not treat 60.3% as a quality gate failure. Explain the increase in terms of evidence added to the population rather than presenting it as a single campaign improvement.

trajectory.label: Discovery-repair full campaign
trajectory.scope: 12 components (behaviour_engine direct test suites for credit_dependency.py + temporal.py added)

trajectory.label: Population expansion via C42.25 targeted smoke (intelligence admission)

delta_attribution.c42_21_to_c42_24_attribution: C42.22/C42.23 strengthening closed genuine test gaps in cashflow, recommendation, financial_events, behaviour (discovery + behavioural scaffolding). Some of these gains also reduced no_tests via discovery repair; some increased killed via new direct tests.
delta_attribution.c42_24_to_c42_24b_attribution: C42.24-B built direct test suites for previously-0%-coverage modules in behaviour_engine (credit_dependency.py + temporal.py). no_tests 2835 -> 1955 (-880). New direct assertions killed an additional 613 mutants in behaviour_engine.
delta_attribution.c42_24b_to_c42_26_attribution: MATHEMATICAL (not measurement-driven). Adding two components (transaction_intelligence 70.2% and financial_intelligence 73.0%) — both scoring substantially above the weakest existing components (behaviour 35.7%, common_calculations 56.4%, ledger_audit 56.8%, financial_events 64.5%, recommendation 63.5%) — to a 12-component aggregate that has 6 components below 75% necessarily raises the aggregate. This is a property of evidence-set composition, not a new measurement.

interpretation.kind_of_improvement: MATHEMATICAL — evidence-set composition effect, not a campaign-driven improvement
interpretation.what_drove_the_aggregate_higher: Two strong-scoring intelligence components were added; they have notably higher mutation scores than the weakest components in the existing 12-component population. The aggregate now provides a more complete representation of the repository's tested production population, but this is not the same as saying 'the test system got better' — it is saying 'we now have evidence about more of the system'.
interpretation.what_still_needs_work: behaviour_engine (35.7%) — still has 1955 no_tests in partially-covered modules + 3383 survivors. This is the genuine priority. The mathematical aggregate is not the focus; the capability-level discrimination is.

do_not_chase_80.warning: An 80% aggregate is not the objective. The objective is sufficient discrimination of production behavior. A future agent must not initiate more mutation strengthening solely to push 60.3% toward 80%.
do_not_chase_80.alternative_objective: Which production capabilities remain insufficiently discriminated by the verification system? (See M26.9 capability matrix.)
